description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Directs that maximum retail price, batch number etc., shall be legibly printed on packs, containers or on wrappers of all articles/goods
reasoning: This gazette contains a Direction (No. 71) issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under Section 10(1)(a) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes new regulatory requirements for product labeling, specifying mandatory information that must be printed on various consumer goods. This content fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it constitutes subsidiary legislation (a statutory instrument) that creates compliance requirements for businesses.
